lines.t: My children, struggle not against the principles of another
Nor rebuke them with your own words
Nor correct them by your own understanding
Let it go of your personal lotions of right and wrong
And strive to love others in spite of yourselves
And have compassion for those with whom you disagree
I'll not judge them, nor shun them in your heart
Rather love those who speak against you
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
And pray for those who mistreat you
As it is written, says the Lord
